LINK R1 OPPOSITION LANDOWNERS’ NOTICE OF CORRECTIONS TO
ATTACHMENT A AND B OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

On June 5, 2026, at the Pre-Hearing Conference, Attorney Luke W. Davis brought the
information below to the attention of the Administrative Law Judges (“ALJs”). The information
in this notice is the same information that was provided on the record. Accordingly, Link R1

Opposition Landowners provide the following:

On Attachment A, exhibits to be admitted at the pre-hearing conference should include
Exhibits 1-5 (pre-filed direct testimony) and Exhibits 6, 7, and 11 (Response to RFIs). Exhibits
8, 9, and 10 are exhibits intended to be used for cross-examination and should not be on the pre-

admitted list.

For Attachment B, on page 21, Link R1 Opposition Landowners have been provided
with “Party No.” 664. Chase B. Akin is listed as Party No. 665; however, he is part of the Link
R1 Opposition Landowners. Additionally, Link R1 Opposition Landowners were given an
additional number, Party No. 667. Numbers 664, 665, and 667 are all Link R1 Opposition

Landowners.
